description: Defines the Worker class for handling web and service workers within the Playwright core library, including event handling, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web or service worker, managing its lifecycle, event subscriptions, and evaluation capabilities.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Returns a Worker instance from a channel object or null if undefined.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns a Worker instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Worker instance, sets up event subscriptions and close handling.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the worker.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the worker context, returning the result.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the worker context, returning a handle to the result.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to occur on the worker, with optional predicate or timeout.
